nodes.label: ADR-006 — GitHub Repository Governance Baseline
nodes.rationale: Adopts a staged, evidence-bound GitHub governance model where GitHub is the remote review/publication surface but not the authority for exact-hash certification or local canonical integration; rejects normal GitHub rebase merging because it rewrites reviewed commit identity and can invalidate exact-hash evidence; stages required-checks activation only after real successful runs to avoid locking out legitimate maintenance; temporarily reduces required approving reviews from 1 to 0 for a bounded AS-GH-001 bootstrap window (sole collaborator cannot self-approve) while keeping PR-required, admin-enforcement, linear-history and force-push/deletion protections enabled.
